name: Fauna (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
A connection to fauna is a connection to the non-vegetative living beings of the world. They are suffused with the primal animal energies around them.

Manifestation: This connection could manifest as an animalistic demeanor, a feral smell or the ever-presence of minor animal life in the character’s presence.

Communing: Communing with fauna could be observing animal movements, petting a cherished animal friend or holding a cast off part of an animal like a feather, claw or tooth.

Connection Spells:

(1st-level/0th)–summon minor ally
(2nd-level/1st)–magic fang
(4th-level/2nd)–animal trance
(6th-level/3rd)-greater magic fang
(8th-level/4th)–animal ambassador
(10th-level/5th)–animal growth
(12th-level/6th)-share skin
(14th-level/7th)-legendary proportions
(16th-level/8th)–animal shapes
(18th-level/9th)–antipathy or sympathy (chosen when communing to regain spells)

Added Spells to Learn: Spells with animals in the name, spells that target animals, summon animals, vermin or magical beasts or allow you to change form into animals, vermin or magical beasts. If you learn spells that let you transform into animals, vermin, magical beasts and other creatures that are not already on the druid spell list, you can only transform into animals, vermin, or magical beasts with the spells.

Primal Empathy: The conduits may communicate with animals, magical beasts, and vermin with an Intelligence score of 3 or lower as if they shared a language.

Natural Skill: Diplomacy

Natural Movement: In addition to the normal benefits, the conduit may ignore difficult terrain from crowds and is immune to a swarm’s distraction ability.

Direct the Beasts (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, so long as the conduit has 1 primal point remaining, they may use Diplomacy in place of Handle Animal to improve the attitude of an animal or magical beast.

Additionally, they can expend a primal point as a swift action to grant a bonus on the next attack roll of an animal or magical beast that is at least at friendly disposition. The target creature must be within 30 feet and the bonus is equal to 1/2 the conduit’s class level.

If the conduit is in the form of an animal or magical beast, they can grant this bonus to themselves.

Bestial Connection (Su)

At 5th level, as long as the conduit has at least 1 primal point remaining, they can detect the presence and location of any creature of the animal and vermin type as the spell detect animals or plants in a 60 ft. radius around the conduit. At 8th level, this ability extends to magical beasts.

Concentrating on this effect is a swift action each round.

Additionally, the conduit may expend a primal point as a swift action to learn more information on a number of creatures in the area equal to 1/2 their class levels.

The conduit learns the exact hit points and information on the creature as if they had rolled a 10 on the requisite Knowledge check to identify the creature.

Bestial Anathema (Sp)

At 9th level, the conduit may spend a primal point to produce an effect that creates an antipathy spell effect for animals and vermin for 1 minute per conduit level using the force of nature saving throw DC for the Will save. At 12th level this effect extends to magical beasts, however, such creatures gain a +5 bonus to their Will save to resist the effect.

This ability usage cannot counter or dispel a sympathy spell effect.

Bestial Dominion (Sp)

At 13th level, the conduit may spend a primal point to use the dominate animal spell with the force of nature’s DC. This ability affects creatures of the animal and vermin types, but may also affect magical beasts. Magical beasts gain a +5 bonus to their Will save against the effect. The HD of the affected creature may not exceed the conduit’s class levels. The conduit may only have one creature dominated in this way. They may release a dominated creature as a free action though the affected animal’s attitude is hostile upon its release. On a successful save, the creature is immediately hostile but has the shaken condition for 1d6 rounds.

Bestial Lordship (Su)

At 17th level, the conduit no longer needs to have primal points remaining for the ongoing effects of the direct the beasts or bestial connection abilities and the radius of bestial connection extends to 120 ft. Their bestial anathema ability lasts for 10 minutes per level and magical beasts no longer gain a bonus to their Will save.

Additionally, no creature of the animal, vermin or magical beast types may attack the conduit unless magically compelled or attacked by the conduit first. In either case, they must make a Will save or be shaken while within 30 feet of the conduit if of indifferent or lower disposition.
